name: Augusta
quote: When the rules are rigged, power turns into a weapon of destruction. Yet as I rewrite those rules with my own power, I realize just how much I still need to learn to keep Septimont balanced and to lead as a true ruler.

name: Lynae
quote: A bright, big place to call my own. Friends to learn with. Allies to fight Everything I've ever wanted is right here. So even when the training is over, this doesn't just end, right? Keep teaching me. Trust me with more. This peace, this beautiful life... I'm going to fight like hell to protect it.

name: Mornye
quote: This takes me back to my first journey to the frostlands. Wind and snow stung my cheeks. It was the first time I felt alive, after a lifetime in a wheelchair. Thank you for bringing that feeling back to me... once again.
